cells.label: fact
cells.reason: Firm reports trailing 12-month production and client assets for recruited advisors across its channels, which are results of recruiting efforts.

items.text: For fiscal 2026, Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $538 million for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels, up from $407 million in the prior year, representing more than $82 billion in client assets.
items.quote: Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $538 million for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million from the prior year. Those advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: In fiscal 2025, Raymond James recruited advisors with prior production of over $400 million, up 21% over the prior year's record.
items.quote: in fiscal 2025, we recruited production advisors with prior production of over $400 million, which was up 21% over last year's record

items.text: Through the first nine months of fiscal 2026, Raymond James recruited advisors with trailing 12-month production totaling $393 million and more than $56 billion of client assets at their previous firms.
items.quote: Through the first 9 months of the fiscal year, we recruited advisers with trailing 12-month production totaling $393 million and more than $56 billion of client assets at their previous firms

items.text: In the fiscal third quarter of 2026, Raymond James recruited financial advisors to its domestic independent contractor and employee channels with trailing 12-month production totaling $156 million and nearly $23 billion of client assets at their previous firms.
items.quote: During the quarter, we recruited financial advisers to our domestic independent contractor and employee channels with trailing 12- month production totaling $156 million and nearly $23 billion of client assets at their previous firms
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: In the fiscal second quarter of 2026, Raymond James recruited financial advisors to its domestic independent contractor and employee channels with trailing 12-month production totaling $141 million and nearly $21 billion of client assets, its second-highest quarterly result in history for both recruited production and assets.
items.quote: We recruited financial advisers to our domestic independent contractor and employee channels, with trailing 12-month production totaling $141 million, nearly $21 billion of client assets at their previous firms. The second highest quarterly result in our history in terms of both recruited production and assets.
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: Over the 12 months ended March 2025, Raymond James recruited into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels financial advisors with approximately $316 million of trailing 12-month production and $50 billion of client assets at their previous firms.
items.quote: Over the past 12 months, we recruited into our domestic independent contractor and employee channels financial advisors with approximately $316 million of trailing 12-month production and $50 billion of client assets at their previous firms
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: Over the prior 12 months (as of December 2024), Raymond James recruited financial advisors with approximately $318 million of trailing 12-month production and $51 billion of client assets to its domestic independent contractor and employee channels.
items.quote: Over the prior 12 months, we recruited financial advisors with approximately $318 million of trailing 12-month production and $51 billion of client assets at their previous firms to our domestic independent contractor and employee channels
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: Including assets recruited into its RIA and Custody Services division, Raymond James recruited total client assets of nearly $61 billion across all of its platforms over the prior 12 months (as of December 2024).
items.quote: Including assets recruited into our RIA and Custody Services Division, which we refer to as RCS, we recruited total client assets over the past 12 months of nearly $61 billion across all of our platforms

items.text: Including assets recruited into its RIA and custody services division, Raymond James recruited total client assets of nearly $59 billion across all of its platforms over the past 12 months (as of March 2025).
items.quote: Including assets recruited into our RIA and custody services division, we recruited total client assets over the past 12 months of nearly $59 billion across all of our platforms

items.text: In the last 12 months (as of December 2025), Raymond James recruited advisors who had $460 million at their prior firms, which CEO Paul Shoukry described as equivalent to a decent-size acquisition.
items.quote: in the last 12 months, we recruited advisors who had $460 million at their prior firms. That's equivalent to a pretty decent size acquisition in our space

items.text: Raymond James ended its fiscal 2026 with a record 8,943 advisors, a 2% increase year-over-year.
items.quote: Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors - a 2% increase year-over-year

items.text: Raymond James recruited a Washington, D.C.-based three-advisor team that previously managed over $1.5 billion in client assets at PNC Private Bank, operating as KKM Wealth Partners within Alex. Brown.
items.quote: Raymond James has recruited a Washington, D.C.-based three-advisor team that previously managed over $1.5 billion in client assets at PNC Private Bank. The team will operate as KKM Wealth Partners within Alex. Brown

items.text: Two Virginia wealth managers moved their practice to Raymond James & Associates, adding more than $1.2 billion in client assets to the employee advisor channel.
items.quote: Two veteran Virginia wealth managers have moved their practice to Raymond James & Associates, adding more than $1.2 billion in client assets to the firm's employee advisor channel

items.text: Raymond James recruited a team of advisors in Southwest Florida to its Financial Institutions Division managing about $700 million in client assets from Truist Investment Services.
items.quote: Raymond James has recruited a team of advisors in Southwest Florida to its Financial Institutions Division... The team, which manages about $700 million in client assets

items.text: Raymond James added two teams in one week totaling $1.75 billion: a $1.25 billion Iowa-based group to its employee advisor channel and a $500 million Rochester, N.Y. team to its independent channel.
items.quote: Raymond James added two teams this week, including a $1.25 billion Iowa-based group that joined its employee advisor channel and a $500 million team out of Rochester, N.Y. via its independent channel

items.text: Raymond James added financial advisors Harold Le Sage Jr., Jeanette Mattiza and Madison Maggard to Raymond James & Associates; the team previously managed more than $550 million in client assets at UBS Financial Services.
items.quote: the team previously managed more than $550 million in client assets at UBS Financial Services

items.text: Raymond James Financial Services welcomed a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network to its independent advisor channel, adding approximately $500 million in client assets.
items.quote: Raymond James Financial Services (RJFS) welcomed a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network to its independent advisor channel, adding approximately $500 million in client assets

items.text: Independent financial advisor Jeffrey Stillwell affiliated with Raymond James Financial Services, managing approximately $240 million in client assets at his prior firm, Ameriprise Financial Services.
items.quote: He managed approximately $240 million in client assets at his old firm, Ameriprise Financial Services

items.text: David Lazorik joined RJFS as branch manager in Yakima, Washington, having managed more than $160 million in client assets at Wells Fargo over a 35-year career.
items.quote: At Wells Fargo he managed more than $160 million in client assets over a 35-year career
